# Quad9 over udp: SYNTHESISED answers in the shape Quad9 documents (blocks are NXDOMAIN or SERVFAIL
# with EDE 15/16/17 and an empty authority; a real NXDOMAIN carries the zone's SOA; locally
# synthesised NXDOMAINs carry EDE 29). Quad9 was unreachable from the recording network on
# 2026-11-21; replace with live recordings (see ../README.md). DoT/DoH answers carry RFC 8467
# Padding to 468-byte blocks, as Quad9 pads replies to padded queries.
